evals.prompt: Set up my cross-AI reviewers for this project.
evals.expected_output: Runs detection first, then the check-providers report, and asks which reviewers to use before writing any config.
assertions: Runs detect-runtimes before asking any reviewer question
Runs check-providers after detection and shows its lines without blocking setup

evals.prompt: Just check which reviewers are available, and do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs the --check-only path: detection, a quota probe on a throwaway path, and check-providers, with no writes to config or caches.
assertions: Keeps the run read-only and removes its scratch path before stopping
Runs check-providers in the --check-only branch and relays its lines

evals.prompt: Write my reviewer config to the global review-spec file in the ai-kit config directory, not the project.
evals.expected_output: Asks before writing the global file, and runs check-providers after detection in the normal setup branch.
assertions: Asks for explicit confirmation before writing the global review-spec file
Runs check-providers --cwd after detect-runtimes --save in the normal branch

evals.prompt: Run setup. My local review-spec has an opencode reviewer on gone/model-x, and the live opencode listing no longer includes gone.
evals.expected_output: Shows the check-providers warning line naming the provider and the file, and continues setup without stopping on it.
assertions: Shows the check-providers warning line naming the provider and the file
Does not block or stop setup because of the warning

evals.prompt: opencode is not installed on this machine, but my opencode.jsonc defines a provider called mine, and a reviewer uses mine/m.
evals.expected_output: Reports the served providers as config file only, keeps the unconfirmed qualifier on any warning, and does not call the provider stale.
assertions: Keeps the unconfirmed qualifier and does not call the provider stale
Reports the served-providers line as config file only, not as a live listing

evals.prompt: There is already a ./.aikit/review-spec.toml in this project. Set up my reviewers again.
evals.expected_output: Asks before replacing the existing local config, and still runs check-providers as part of the setup.
assertions: Asks before replacing the existing local review-spec file
Runs check-providers during setup even when the local config already exists
